featured_reviews.name: Nitish Pillai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Neelam Nagar Swimming Pool is a great place for swimmers of all levels, whether you're a beginner or looking to refine your technique. The coaching staff here is excellent—knowledgeable, patient, and always willing to provide tips to improve your strokes. They pay attention to individual progress, making it an ideal spot for both casual swimmers and those training seriously.

The pool is 25 meters long, well-maintained, and operates with convenient timings: mornings from 6 AM to 10 AM and evenings from 4 PM to 8 PM. These slots work well for early risers as well as those who prefer swimming after work or school.

One thing to note is that during vacations, the pool tends to get quite crowded as many kids join for swimming lessons. Additionally, with Kalidas Swimming Pool currently closed for renovation, the demand here has significantly increased. Despite the rush, the staff is helpful and ensures a smooth experience for everyone.

Overall, if you're looking for a pool with great coaching and a supportive environment, Neelam Nagar Swimming Pool is a fantastic choice!

I was referred to Aqua centre for my special needs daughter's physiotherapy. My first impressions were - quite neat, well maintained, compact centre with a polite receptionist, competitive charges, ready to accommodate our request for preferred time slots, headed by an assertive but polite pediatric physiotherapist, dedicated to her work with a command on her subject and a no nonsense attitude.
We have been with Dr Purvi for 8 months and I have seen my child gain, under Dr Purvi's expert care and guidance, both, physical skills and self-confidence. I have noticed improvent in her balance and coordination, speed of walking and running, strength and endurance. She was taught to jump and cycle by Dr Purvi - today she enjoys riding her cycle in our society premises. Her gait improved. Her response time for tasks/commands/questions has reduced. Dr Purvi takes a genuine and personal interest in each kid and creates a customised program unique to their needs. She not just helped  my child to achieve some of her developmental milestones but also helped and guided me by regularly motivating me, providing emotional support, giving me home program  to build on the therapy conducted at the centre, gave behavioural correction advice, provided contacts of schools, educators and other specialists whenever I requested her. She went out of her way to help us as a family. I could share my smallest concerns about my daughter with her and she always had some useful advice to help with them. The therapy provided to my daughter at Aqua centre was very well rounded ( mix of physiotherapy, occupational therapy, some vision activities, sensory integration and aqua therapy) Aqua therapy, in which Dr Purvi is an expert and very well trained was the most fun for my daughter (very well maintained temperature controlled pool, great care taken for safety of each child).
I highly recommend Aqua Therapy Centre for all kinds of physical therapy and Aqua Therapy. Their genuine desire to help each family that approaches them reflects in the hard work they put during each session and kids who continue to visit the centre for years.They do not work with a commercial mindset. Therapy charges are very reasonable. (I have been witness to many families who cannot afford expensive therapy, get help at this centre). I Congratulate Dr Purvi and her team for the many families they have helped and wish them all the success in future!

featured_reviews.name: Mohit Tibrewal
featured_reviews.review_text:
The swimming pool at Naval Colony, Kanjurmarg, operated under the Michael Phelps Swimming brand, charges a very high rate for the general public (non-Naval), which comes to around ₹600–₹800 per visit when calculated from their package rates.

While the premium pricing is justified in their advertisements by the claim of temperature-controlled water, the reality is different — the temperature control system has not been operational for the past two years. Based on discussions with regular users, the reason appears to be an unresolved dispute between the Navy and the Michael Phelps Swimming management regarding electricity bill payments. Unfortunately, there is no sign of this being resolved soon.

New customers are still enrolled with temperature control advertised as a key USP, without disclosure of the ongoing issue. This amounts to misleading information.

For Naval employees, the rates are minimal, making it a great facility. However, for the general public, given the lack of temperature control, the pricing feels unreasonable.

Pros:
Good training facility and structured programs
Ideal for Naval employees due to subsidized rates

Cons:
Very high rates for non-Naval public
False/misleading advertisement regarding temperature control
No clarity on resolution of the temperature control issue

Recommendation:
If temperature control matters to you, speak to current regular users before enrolling.

featured_reviews.name: Supreme Kothari
featured_reviews.review_text:
The idea of personal coaching during a 40-minute session here seems to run entirely on luck—and unfortunately, luck doesn’t favor everyone every day. Like today, for instance—my daughter got a few seconds of attention right at the end, while the coach’s focus remained firmly on a younger child throughout. Maybe there’s a secret lottery system? If so, we’d love to know how to sign up.

Also, during rains (like on 1st June), it’s perfectly normal here for most coaches to simply step out while kids are left to figure things out on their own. Because, of course, why would Michael Phelps’ name imply any higher standard, especially in India?

And yes, batch change chaos is part of life—we get that. But if it regularly eats into actual swimming time, then it stops being "chaos" and starts becoming bad planning.

If there’s some unofficial premium fee that buys actual attention, please do let us know. We'd be happy to pay, instead of just crossing our fingers each time.

We expected the name to come with certain standards. Right now, it feels more like a branding exercise than a coaching one.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for taking the time to share such a detailed and honest review. We sincerely apologize for the experience you and your daughter had—it clearly fell short of the standards we aim to uphold.

At Michael Phelps Swimming, we take great pride in providing quality coaching and structured attention to each swimmer, regardless of age or level. Your feedback highlights areas where we must improve, and we are treating it with the seriousness it deserves.

We understand your concern about the uneven attention during sessions and the lack of supervision during rainy-day disruptions. This is not aligned with our coaching philosophy, and we are already addressing this with the team involved. Additionally, we agree that operational issues such as batch transitions should not interfere with your child’s training time, and we’re actively working on making these smoother and more efficient.

There is no premium fee or preferential treatment in our program—every swimmer deserves equal care, and our team is expected to deliver that consistently.

Please reach out to us at info@wavelinesports.com so we understand your daughter’s current progress, and ensure she receives the guidance and support she needs.

Thank you once again for highlighting these issues. Your feedback is crucial in helping us improve and rebuild your trust.

The entire space, from the pool to the changing areas, is kept extremely clean, adding to the sense of professionalism and care that the facility offers.
